svg.aria-label: Commercial work: Tender monitoring agent: Pulls tenders from procurement platforms, reads the attached documents and scores each one for relevance.; Telegram sales agent: Handles customer chats for a retail shop end to end. It replaced the shop's sales managers.; Knowledge-base agents: Turn team chats into a daily-updated knowledge base and answer new employees' questions over it with RAG.; Multi-agent platform: Seven agents for a production business on one shared knowledge layer, with OCR and CI checks.
